name: Intra Balance Query Criteria 11
definition: Defines the criteria based on which information is included.

References.name: References
References.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account in which cash is maintained.

CashAccountServicer.name: Cash Account Servicer
CashAccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the cash account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

BalanceType.name: Balance Type
BalanceType.definition: Balance to which the amount of money is moved.

CashSubBalanceIdentification.name: Cash Sub Balance Identification
CashSubBalanceIdentification.definition: Number identifying a lot constituting the sub-balance.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be settled.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Amount of money effectively settled and which will be credited to/debited from the account owner's cash account. It may differ from the instructed settlement amount based on market tolerance level.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency in which the instructed amount is expressed.

IntendedSettlementDate.name: Intended Settlement Date
IntendedSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the amount of money is intended to be moved.

EffectiveSettlementDate.name: Effective Settlement Date
EffectiveSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the amount of money is moved.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

MessageOriginator.name: Message Originator
MessageOriginator.definition: Party that originated the message, if other than the sender.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Specifies the creation date/time of the intra-balance movement.
